name: Berry Picnic
about: Berry Picnic is the holiday release. Its deck, Picnic Club, is a picnic with friends: someone made the plans, everyone brought the wrong snacks, the goose was not invited, and the ants always show up. When a friend heads home, they pass their plate on: that is the deck's mechanic, Leftovers. Three cards sold on their own are wintry and festive.
style: Basil's own style. Found family, low stakes, a little feral: cute, silly and a little chaotic, with running jokes (the ants, the goose, the forks nobody brought). The paid cards are showcase art.

Berry.world: a picnic in the grass: a gingham blanket, a basket, berries, friends, sunshine
Berry.note: the deck's family; every Berry card should feel like the same picnic

pictures.draw: Ginger, the Gingerbread Baker: a cat baker in oven mitts and flour dust, with a tray of gingerbread cats iced with :3 faces, one of them bitten.
